candidates.title: The Invisible Guest
candidates.reason: The apparently impossible locked-room killing and an earlier concealed hit-and-run remain central throughout the film. The attorney's interrogation systematically tests Adrián's inconsistent accounts, exposing fresh clues and producing multiple versions of the same events; the audience repeatedly revises who lied, who killed whom and why. Substantive whole-film criticism describes an unusually high cadence of revelations and reversals, strong suspense, visual polish and a coherent final explanation. Limitations: the story's impossibility is a staged crime, not a supernatural or physical anomaly; some solutions depend on highly engineered coincidences, and the affair/relationship is a motive rather than the primary genre. Investigation is active but distinct from the more frequent explanatory reframing.

candidates.title: The Body
candidates.reason: A missing corpse, a panicked morgue guard, contradictory clues and the suspicion that the supposedly dead woman is orchestrating events create a sustained why/how mystery. Inspector Peña's inquiries and Álex's increasingly desperate attempts to interpret evidence continue through the morgue-set night; the drug TH-16, the lover's disputed identity and the detective's past all receive concrete explanations in the finale. Whole-film reviews describe maintained tension, red herrings and a powerful final reversal. Weaknesses: the cycle of ominous clue, attempted cover-up and confrontation becomes repetitive around the middle; much of the largest reframing arrives late, not in a continuous chain; some plotting strains plausibility and the camerawork is less distinctive. The apparently uncanny occurrences ultimately have a human explanation rather than a supernatural one.

research_rejections.title: The Vast of Night
research_rejections.reason: Strong sound-led UFO investigation and cinematic atmosphere, but complete-film reviews describe an intentionally slow, dialogue-heavy path of testimony and suggestions rather than frequent rule discoveries or layered explanatory reframings. The climactic encounter establishes the likely extraterrestrial nature of the signal but leaves the visitors' motives and mechanism mostly unexplained. Rejected qualitatively for this Mystery profile's whole-runtime answer/revelation emphasis, not because the anomalous premise or period visual style is unwelcome. Sources consulted: https://www.rogerebert.com/reviews/the-vast-of-night-movie-review-2020 ; https://www.deepfocusreview.com/reviews/the-vast-of-night/ ; https://www.theguardian.com/film/2020/jun/01/the-vast-of-night-review-twilight-zone-homage
